name: Dabrafenib + Trametinib (BRAF/MEK inhibitor, BRAF V600E/K melanoma)

biomarkers.note: BRAF/MEK inhibitor combination REQUIRES a BRAF V600 activating mutation. This regimen is indicated for BRAF V600E or V600K mutation-positive disease: adjuvant (resected stage III, COMBI-AD) and unresectable/metastatic (COMBI-d, COMBI-v). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Melanoma: Cutaneous, melanomas with BRAF V600E may derive higher adjuvant benefit than V600K (line 2629). Do NOT use in BRAF wild-type disease.

lineOfTherapy: BRAF/MEK-targeted therapy for BRAF V600E/K mutation-positive melanoma: adjuvant for resected stage III, and for unresectable stage III or stage IV disease

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: BRAF V600E or V600K activating mutation present
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, Dabrafenib/Trametinib if BRAF V600 (lines 2198, 2519); adjuvant V600E vs V600K benefit line 2629

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: resected stage III (adjuvant) OR unresectable stage III / stage IV (advanced)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, adjuvant Dabrafenib/Trametinib (line 2543, tested in AJCC 7th ed stage IIIA SLN >=1 mm or IIIB/C); advanced BRAF/MEK combination Table 19, MS-63 to MS-64

drugs.name: Dabrafenib

provenance.locator: Table 19 BRAF/MEK Inhibitor Combination in Advanced Melanoma, NCT01072175 Part C row, MS-63 to MS-64 (lines 8538 to 8541): Dab (150 mg BID) + tram (2 mg QD)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Table 19 (MS-63 to MS-64), treatment arm 'Dab (150 mg BID) + tram (2 mg QD)'. Dabrafenib 150 mg PO TWICE daily (BID) continuously; represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle for scheduling. Taken orally; continuous dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity (advanced) or for up to 1 year (adjuvant).

drugs.name: Trametinib

provenance.locator: Table 19 BRAF/MEK Inhibitor Combination in Advanced Melanoma, NCT01072175 Part C row, MS-63 to MS-64 (lines 8538 to 8541): Dab (150 mg BID) + tram (2 mg QD)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Table 19 (MS-63 to MS-64), treatment arm 'Dab (150 mg BID) + tram (2 mg QD)'. Trametinib 2 mg PO ONCE daily (QD) continuously; represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle for scheduling. Taken orally; continuous dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity (advanced) or for up to 1 year (adjuvant).

regimen.cycles: Continuous oral dosing: dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily plus trametinib 2 mg once daily (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Table 19, MS-63 to MS-64). Adjuvant (resected stage III BRAF V600E/K): given for up to 1 year (COMBI-AD). Advanced (unresectable stage III / stage IV): continued until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity (COMBI-d, COMBI-v). The 28-day cycle is a scheduling container for continuous daily dosing.
supportiveCare: Pyrexia management: dabrafenib/trametinib commonly cause recurrent fever; hold both drugs for fever and resume per labeling.

Baseline and periodic LVEF (echocardiogram) for trametinib-related cardiomyopathy; ophthalmologic assessment for retinal events; dermatologic surveillance for cutaneous squamous-cell carcinoma/keratoacanthoma.
Monitor for MEK-inhibitor toxicities (rash, diarrhea, venous thromboembolism, retinal vein occlusion) per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Table 21 (MS-66 onward).

monitoring: LFTs, CBC, glucose; clinical/radiographic response assessment

doseModificationRules.text: For fever, interrupt dabrafenib (and trametinib per labeling) and resume once resolved; prophylaxis/antipyretics per guidance.

doseModificationRules.condition: decline in LVEF or grade 3 to 4 non-cardiac toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Hold or reduce trametinib for symptomatic or significant asymptomatic LVEF decline, or grade 3 to 4 toxicity, per labeling; obtain clinical review.

core.locator: BRAF/MEK-targeted therapy framework for BRAF V600-mutant melanoma; dosing taken from the guideline layer (Table 19, MS-63 to MS-64)

guideline.locator: Table 19 BRAF/MEK Inhibitor Combination in Advanced Melanoma (Dab 150 mg BID + tram 2 mg QD, NCT01072175 Part C; also COMBI-d, COMBI-v), MS-63 to MS-64 (lines 8538 to 8556); biomarker/setting lines 2198, 2519, 2543, 2629

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for dabrafenib plus trametinib BRAF/MEK-inhibitor combination therapy in BRAF V600E or V600K mutation-positive cutaneous melanoma, covering adjuvant therapy for resected stage III disease and treatment of unresectable stage III or stage IV disease. Both doses are sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Melanoma: Cutaneous v2.2026, Table 19 (MS-63 to MS-64), treatment arm dabrafenib 150 mg twice daily plus trametinib 2 mg once daily, given as continuous oral therapy. This combination requires a confirmed BRAF V600 activating mutation and must not be used in BRAF wild-type disease. Class-specific monitoring is emphasized: pyrexia, LVEF decline, ocular events, and secondary cutaneous malignancy. Every modeled numeric dose is sourced and no field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
